verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents two official SDKs: a Payments React SDK for building agentic card checkouts and a Credits Wallet Embed SDK, though the wallet SDK is limited to Enterprise customers. Its core token, charge and introspect flows are documented only as raw REST APIs plus an MCP server, and no public OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path. missing for 10: general-purpose server-side SDKs (e.g. Python/TypeScript) for token creation, charging and introspection; SDK reference depth and language coverage; independent hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
